nodes.description: Total token supply (1000*10^9*10^18) stored in the private state variable _tTotal.
Mapping of account balances (_balances) mutated by _transfer and the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping (_allowances) mutated by _approve under a privileged owner path.
Ownable ownership slot _owner, set in the constructor and changed by renounce/transferOwnership.
Private state variable newComer = _msgSender() evaluated at construction; used instead of _owner for the onlyOwner check (hidden backdoor).
Token constructor: mints _tTotal to the deployer and initializes Ownable ownership.
Public ERC20 transfer; forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer then re-approves the remaining allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to the private _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Private approval writer that zeroes allowance and emits Approval(...,4) when the sender is not owner(), otherwise stores amount.
Internal balance-moving routine guarded by SafeMath sub/add and zero-address requires.
onlyOwner modifier that requires newComer == _msgSender(), coupling authorization to the newComer state variable rather than _owner.
Owner-guarded function that emits OwnershipTransferred and clears _owner to address(0).
Owner-guarded function that validates newOwner and rewrites _owner (but not newComer).
View function returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View function returning _balances[account].
View function returning the _owner address; consulted inside _approve to branch allowance logic.
View function returning the _tTotal supply.
msg.sender / _msgSender(), the externally controlled caller address feeding transfer, transferFrom, approve, the constructor and the onlyOwner check.
Privileged allowance branch in _approve: when ol != owner() the allowance is forced to 0 and Approval(...,4) is emitted, otherwise the arbitrary amount is written.
Authorization decision of onlyOwner derived from the mutable-at-construction newComer variable instead of _owner, giving a hidden privileged account permanent control of owner-only functions.
Parameter sender of transferFrom/_transfer, the account whose balance is debited.
Parameter recipient of transfer/_transfer, the account whose balance is credited.
Parameter amount of transfer/transferFrom, the value moved between balances and allowances.
Parameter spender of approve, the address granted an allowance.
Parameter ol of _approve, the allowance owner address compared against owner().
Parameter tt of _approve, the allowance target address written into _allowances.
Local variable msgSender captured in the Ownable constructor from _msgSender() and stored into _owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument of transfer and controls whose balance is debited.
msg.sender is the caller of transferFrom and becomes the spender whose allowance is decremented.
msg.sender is passed as ol into _approve by approve, making the caller the allowance owner.
msg.sender receives the whole _tTotal supply in the constructor via _balances[_msgSender()].
msg.sender is compared against newComer inside onlyOwner, so the caller's identity is the sole authorization input.
The caller address flows through approve/transferFrom into _approve where it is tested against owner().
newComer is the value required to equal msg.sender for onlyOwner to succeed, forming the hidden privileged path.
transfer delegates all state mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom invokes the privileged _approve with the remaining allowance, reaching the owner-branch logic.
approve invokes _approve, which decides between zeroing and storing the allowance based on owner().
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient]; integer safety depends on SafeMath.
_approve writes _allowances[ol][tt], either forced to zero with Approval(...,4) or set to the caller-supplied amount.
The constructor initializes _balances[_msgSender()] with _tTotal, establishing the initial supply distribution.
Via the Ownable constructor the deployer address is written into _owner.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership, so possessing newComer grants the ability to zero the owner slot.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership, so possessing newComer grants the ability to reassign ownership.
renounceOwnership rewrites _owner to address(0), permanently disabling owner()-based privilege.
transferOwnership rewrites _owner to newOwner but leaves newComer untouched, decoupling the two authorization sources.
Execution of _approve reaches the unsafe owner/allowance branch that can silently zero a spender's allowance.
Evaluation of the onlyOwner modifier reaches the unsafe newComer-based authorization decision.
owner() is read inside _approve to decide whether the requested allowance is discarded or honored.
allowance() exposes the stored _allowances value for owner/spender pairs.
balanceOf() exposes the stored _balances value for an account.
totalSupply() exposes the _tTotal state variable.
The caller supplied via msg.sender is the untrusted operand of the newComer equality check, enabling unauthorized owners.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a plain call argument only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom/_transfer; fold it into the calling function.
recipient is a transient argument of the value-moving entry point and carries no independent semantic identity.
amount is the arithmetic operand passed from the entry point into _transfer; represent it through the enclosing function node.
spender exists only to name the allowance target inside approve and should be absorbed by that function node.
ol is the local alias for the allowance owner inside _approve and is compared with owner(); it has no standalone meaning.
tt is the local alias for the allowance target written by _approve and should be unified with that unsafe operation.
msgSender is a temporary holding the deployer address during construction and maps directly onto the constructor's initialization flow.
